question: Estimate the number of e-commerce delivery agents (last-mile) needed for pan-India coverage.
idealClarificationQuestions: Last-mile delivery workforce across all e-commerce (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra) and courier partners (Delhivery, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, Xpressbees)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily e-commerce orders pan-India (physical goods): ~5.5 crore orders/365 = ~1.5 crore daily.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily agents needed (delivery workforce active that day): 1.5 cr / 25 = ~6 lakh agents.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Including pick-up + sortation + Hub-to-spoke workers: total e-commerce logistics workforce: ~15-18 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~9-10 lakh active last-mile delivery agents.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average orders per agent per day
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~20-30 (varies by city density; metros higher, Tier 2/3 lower).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Daily agents needed (delivery workforce active that day)
Considering shift work + leave + churn (employed pool > daily active)

calculationFlow: Daily e-commerce orders pan-India (physical goods): ~5.5 crore orders/365 = ~1.5 crore daily.
Daily agents needed (delivery workforce active that day): 1.5 cr / 25 = ~6 lakh agents.
Considering shift work + leave + churn (employed pool > daily active): ~9-10 lakh total.
Including pick-up + sortation + Hub-to-spoke workers: total e-commerce logistics workforce: ~15-18 lakh.
Round: ~9-10 lakh active last-mile delivery agents.
